Call of Juarez.name: Call of Juarez
Call of Juarez.summary: Call of Juarez is an epic adventure western themed FPS game. The player alternately assumes the roles of two distinct, antagonistic characters: a sneaking fugitive Billy and his hunter the reverend Ray. Injustice - Gods Among Us - Ultimate Edi.name: Injustice: Gods Among Us - Ultimate Edition
Injustice - Gods Among Us - Ultimate Edi.summary: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition enhances the bold new franchise to the fighting game genre from NetherRealm Studios. Featuring six new playable characters, over 30 new skins, and 60 new S.T.A.R. Labs missions, this edition packs a punch. In addition to DC Comics icons such as Batman, The Joker, Green Lantern, The Flash, Superman and Wonder Woman, the latest title from the award-winning studio presents a deep original story. Heroes and villains will engage in epic battles on a massive scale in a world where the line between good and evil has been blurred.

Madden NFL 12.name: Madden NFL 12
Madden NFL 12.summary: Play and manage football matches between real NFL teams, featuring the latest player lineups of 2012!

Need for Speed - Carbon.name: Need for Speed: Carbon
Need for Speed - Carbon.summary: Need for Speed: Carbon is an arcade-style street racing game set in an open-world city. Players compete in illegal night races across different event types, including circuits, sprints, drifting, and canyon duels on winding mountain roads, while evading police pursuits. Cars are drawn from licensed real-world models across tuner, muscle, and exotic classes, and can be heavily tuned and visually customized. A key feature is the crew system, in which players recruit AI wingmen with specialized roles to assist during races and take over rival-controlled territories.

Red Dead Redemption.name: Red Dead Redemption
Red Dead Redemption.summary: A modern-day Western epic, Red Dead Redemption takes John Marston, a relic from the fast-closing time of the gunslinger, through an open world filled with wildlife, mini-games, and shootouts. Marston sets out to hunt down his old gang mates for the government, who have taken away his family. Along his journey, he meets many characters emblematic of the Wild West, heroism, and the new civilization.

Rock Band Track Pack - Classic Rock.name: Rock Band Track Pack: Classic Rock
Rock Band Track Pack - Classic Rock.summary: Rock Band Track Pack Classic Rock is a standalone title that allows owners of Rock Band and Rock Band 2 to keep the party going with 20 seminal hits from the heyday of classic rock and beyond, hand-picked with care by Harmonix.
